features.heading: Built for finance teams
features.subheading: From the first card to the final close, everything lives in one place.

feature1.title: All your data, connected
feature1.desc: Import accounts, cards, and ledgers from any source in minutes.

feature2.title: Always in sync
feature2.desc: Balances and transactions update in real time across every device and teammate.

feature3.title: Role-based access
feature3.desc: Give each person exactly the permissions they need, with a full audit trail.

feature4.title: One clear dashboard
feature4.desc: Cash, spend, and forecasts on a single screen your whole team can read.

feature5.title: Automation that works for you
feature5.desc: Categorize expenses and match invoices without manual work.

feature6.title: Forecasts you can trust
feature6.desc: See runway and cash flow months ahead, updated as your numbers change.
